name: Lushwater Oasis
summary: South of the Crossroads, Lushwater Oasis is one of three life-giving watering holes in the Barrens. Kolkar centaur threaten travelers who come for its water, while the tainted pools draw anglers seeking Deviate Fish.

sections.title: A Precarious Sanctuary
sections.body: Lushwater Oasis lies a short march south of the Crossroads, beneath the Barrens sun. Its palms and springs draw thirsty beasts, but Kolkar centaur hold the banks and ambush wildlife and travelers. The oasis also marks the entrance to the Wailing Caverns. Energies from its underground passages taint the pools, where unnatural creatures and strange mutations take hold.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Wailing Caverns located?
faq.answer: The entrance to the Wailing Caverns lies in the natural rock faces overlooking the eastern side of Lushwater Oasis.
Kolkar centaur dominate Lushwater Oasis. They use its cover to hunt wildlife and attack travelers coming from the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why are the fish here strange?
faq.answer: Energies from the Wailing Caverns taint the oasis waters, mutating local fish into unusual Deviate Fish.

faq.q: Did Thrall's Horde travel through here?
faq.answer: During the orcs' Long March through the Barrens with the tauren, Thrall led his troops through the scattered oases for drinking water while they fought off centaur ambushes.

angles.text: Anglers can catch Deviate Fish in these pools. The fish are a vital ingredient in Savory Deviate Delights, prized across Kalimdor.
As a druid, you can see troubling overgrowth at Lushwater Oasis, driven by twisted energies escaping the nearby Wailing Caverns.
